title: win-loss-quarterly template variables
description: Values for templates/win-loss-quarterly.md.j2 and templates/win-loss-quarterly.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from win-loss-quarterly.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

buyer_interviews.title: Buyer interviews
buyer_interviews.description: How many actual buyers were interviewed, as opposed to reps asked what the buyer thought? Five is the floor, and this is the number the whole report rests on.

crm_discrepancy_pct.title: Crm discrepancy pct
crm_discrepancy_pct.description: In what share of deals did the buyer's account of why they bought or left disagree with the rep's CRM note? This number is what tells you how much of the CRM to trust.

losses_count.title: Losses count
losses_count.description: How many losses were reviewed? Also fifteen minimum, and reviewed by the same method as the wins or the comparison is worthless.

period_label.description: Which quarter does this synthesis cover (e.g. 2026-Q3)? Deals close across quarter boundaries, so say which side of the line you counted them on.

wins_count.title: Wins count
wins_count.description: How many wins were reviewed? Fifteen is the floor - below it a theme is one salesperson's opinion with a number attached.
